packageRules.description: A Markdown guide whose name looks like a Dockerfile to Renovate: its example images aren't dependencies
CI tests the skill scripts on the oldest Python they promise (ci.yml): raise it on purpose, not on release
Eve's local store carries a patch for its exact version (runtime/eve-world/README.md): an update has to move the patch with it, and @workflow/world stays on the version that store is built for
